source: CAMIL GE-V-13 · Page 26 · Bedroom and Bathroom (bedroom half)
notes: BOARD normalised to 'headboard' and FRAME to 'bed frame'. Bare 'board' and 'frame' say
nothing in a bedroom, and 'frame' would collide with the picture frame in The Living Room.
'spring' kept at Leon's call: resorte is still what it means.
'wardrobe' also appears in Clothes. Different areas, and the sense is the same piece of
furniture, so the repetition reinforces rather than confuses.

area.name: The Bedroom
area.description: La alcoba: la cama y todo lo que lleva encima, y los muebles donde se guarda la ropa.

units.name: The bed
units.topic: The bed and everything on it. The headboard is the panel at the head of the bed, the bed frame is the structure holding the mattress, and a spring is one of the metal coils inside a mattress

units.name: Bedroom furniture
units.topic: What stands around a bed: where clothes are kept and where things are put down
